variants.prompt: Create a NEW original photorealistic cinematic concept for a vast civilian space station in deep space. Architectural scale is absolutely central: this station is a CITY IN SPACE, not a building or ship with ordinary storeys. Its body is organized into THREE HUGE vertically stacked LEVELS or districts; each of the three primary levels spans MANY internal storeys, passages and buildings, not one room height. Three major layers remain readable as three broad architectural volumes, but each volume is covered in numerous rows of MINUSCULE pinpoint windows at human scale, like a distant megacity skyline; windows are tiny, not panoramic. No individual furniture, people or trees can be distinguished through windows, no single row of giant room-size glass panes. The lower volume is largely technical and cargo, the middle and upper are livable districts; all volumes form ONE integrated, solid-connected and plausible engineered station. The structure feels vast through fine dense micro-scale windows and very small service craft in the distance, without any numeric dimensions or labels. Elegant peaceful Eden aesthetic: light warm-white and silver-grey structural metal, restrained architectural geometry, warm tiny lights, believable slight wear and industrial detail, no weaponry. Entire structure framed from an elevated side three-quarter angle, clearly revealing vertical architecture and complete silhouette against black starfield. Balanced proportions, graceful contours, no disjointed blocks, no decorative sharp giant spikes, no typography, no logos, no infographics. LANDSCAPE 16:9. Overall geometry is a perfect circular ring with a central core and a few enclosed short bridges, drawn as an ellipse only by perspective. Refined simple continuous circular silhouette, ring thickness slender relative to diameter but deep enough for the three giant macro-levels.
